out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw sausage was observed being stored on top of a container of RTE cooked octopus
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVCED THE RAW SAUSAGE NEXT TO THE OCTOPUS AND ABOVE RAW CHICKEN.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: 1) pulled cooked chicken was observed at 46f and was stored overnight in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. OWNERSHIP DISCARDED THE CHICKEN.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) in the walk-in cooler, tamales and cooked potatoes was observed being stored for longer than 7 days
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. OWNERSHIP DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) cakes being stored in the 3DR glass under cooler at the bar was observed without proper date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO DATE MARK ALL CAKES THAT ARE TO BE STORED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS. EHS PROVIDED OWNERSHIP WITH A DATE MARKING FACT SHEET.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) various squeeze bottles of cooking liquids on the cook line; 2) small spray bottle of aromatic bitters at the bar
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed over 10 percent hot water capacity deficit. Facility has 1 tankless water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of @gph of ##F water at a ##F rise@, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. As an option, the permit holder may choose to remove a newly installed warewashing machine to comply with this requirement. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP TO REMOVE THE DISH MACHINE OR INSTALL A SECOND TANKLESS WATER HEATER IN PARALLEL. MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED OWNERSHIP WITH INFORMATION ABOUT APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICES. PLEASE ORDER AND INSTALL.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Raw chicken was observed being stored above Raw beef
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC MOVED THE CHICKEN TO THE BOTTOM SHELF AND THE BEEF TO THE TOP SHELF. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAY BE WARRANTED IF THIS CONTINUES.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: Observed consumer advisory disclosure statements on the menus. The reminder asterisks next to the food item was not observed for: ceviche and steaks
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. EHS REVIEWED MENUS WITH PIC TO INDICATE WHICH FOOD ITEMS NEED AN ASTERISK. EMAIL EHS A DRAFT OF THE MENUS BEFORE REPRINTING. MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
